purpose: confirm (or not) the moderate-noise finding on unseen initial conditions
checkpoints: the same suite-A checkpoints (runs/conditions/<model>/policy.pt), verified by policy_sha256 in each evaluation identity
mode_definition: re-plan every control step, execute only the first predicted action
success: box-target distance (simulator) < 0.05 m for 10 consecutive valid control steps, protocol v2 (termination-aware)
estimand: mean over the 3 training seeds of the success rate on the 100 fresh initial conditions; contrast = noisy(sigma=0.5) - clean
analysis: per-model success counts and Wilson 95% intervals
per-condition mean of the 3 per-seed success rates
paired bootstrap over the 100 shared initial conditions (20,000 resamples, numpy seed 0), models held fixed: uncertainty conditional on these 3+3 models
two-way bootstrap resampling training seeds within condition AND initial conditions: crude (3 seeds) but includes seed-to-seed variation
exact sign-flip test on per-condition-differences of seed-averaged success per initial condition (10^5 random flips)
per-seed-index differences (seed s noisy - seed s clean) listed, not tested
decision_rule: report 'confirmed' only if the paired initial-condition bootstrap 95% CI of the contrast lies entirely above 0; otherwise report 'not confirmed' with the estimate. The two-way interval is reported alongside as the more conservative statement.
commitments: evaluate once; no re-runs with other evaluation seeds
no tuning, checkpoint or seed replacement based on this set
all 600 episode outcomes are saved and reported
